lens: evidence integrity, privacy, and safe action

findings.criterion: User authorization: deletion effect must match its preview
findings.observation: Confirmed in frozen code and supported by the executed store test: the deletion dialog promises deletion 'from this device' and says saved drafts remain unchanged, but its handler creates a synchronized deletion tombstone and removes this Session's contact proposal. Synchronization deletes the canonical Session; the database also retires screenshot tasks that no other live Session references. The preview understates both the device scope and the draft/processing effect. No native deletion-dialog capture was supplied.
findings.evidence: /tmp/get5-product-review-v1/source/apps/ios/Sources/Features/RelationshipArchiveView.swift:3221-3230 (preview), :704-706 (delete plus sync); source/apps/ios/Sources/Features/RelationshipArchiveModels.swift:1551-1553 (tombstone and proposal removal), :2859-2864 (canonical delete), :2759-2764 (remote tombstone application); source/apps/backend/src/database/054_agent_session_identifier_canonicalization.sql:82-101 (unreferenced screenshot retirement); source/apps/ios/Tests/AgentSessionContinuityTests.swift:293-310; evidence/get5-ios-unit-r8.log:80-81 records that test passing. All source/evidence shorthand paths are relative to /tmp/get5-product-review-v1.
findings.user_impact: A recruiter agreeing to remove a local copy can lose the conversation on another device, an unsaved contact draft, and unfiled screenshot processing context. This crosses the human-decision-to-deletion link with an inaccurately described effect.
findings.recommendation: Make canonical-mode deletion explicitly describe removal of the synced Session across devices, its unsaved Session drafts and unreferenced screenshot tasks. Preserve the accurate separate statement that filed People and workspace evidence follow their own lifecycle. Keep device-only wording only for a truly device-only preview store.
findings.verification: Capture the canonical deletion confirmation in English and Chinese, cancel once and confirm once, then verify two same-owner stores receive the tombstone; the affected proposal and unreferenced screenshot task are removed, while a referenced fork and separately filed source survive according to the displayed scope. Check the preview-mode wording separately.

findings.criterion: Privacy lifecycle: ordinary text replies need Session-linked retention and replay guards
findings.observation: Supported code risk, not a newly executed database result: a text-only Session reply receives no screenshot dependency record. On retry, createUnscopedChatTask returns the stored response before reading Session existence, owner scope or expiry. Its availability check returns true when there is no retracted task and no screenshot dependency. Session expiry/deletion clears agent_sessions.payload, while migration 055's response-body redaction requires a screenshot dependency. Consequently the inspected path retains and can replay a private text-derived answer after the Session is deleted or expires. The same early replay pattern exists in scoped Chat.
findings.evidence: /tmp/get5-product-review-v1/source/apps/backend/src/modules/unscopedChat.ts:224-243 (early replay), :286-287 (dependency record then full response persistence); source/apps/backend/src/modules/agentSessionSources.ts:139-147 (no dependencies means no record); source/apps/backend/src/database/055_agent_session_chat_sources.sql:38-59 (vacuous availability and screenshot-only body redaction); source/apps/backend/src/modules/agentSessions.ts:142-163 (expiry sweep), :654-655 and :708-722 (deleted Session payload); source/apps/backend/src/modules/chat.ts:800-818 (scoped replay). Required unchanged import /Users/cubxxw/data/talent-signal/apps/backend/src/lib/idempotency.ts:96-118 returns/persists response_body; it matches baseline d363ac04 and SHA-256 1a4d4aef5405658493e5a38200f40f9f56e75e9bc0696d71fd12acfdadc3b434. Frozen source/docs/architecture.md:175 states the thirty-day Session boundary. Existing source/apps/backend/src/modules/agentSessions.integration.test.ts:395-464 only proves Session payload/tombstone expiry, not this text-only reply store.
findings.user_impact: Sensitive details repeated by the assistant can remain in a replay store after the conversation's lifecycle ends. The source-to-derived-store deletion boundary is incomplete even when the native transcript correctly disappears.
findings.recommendation: Record the owning Session for every Session-backed Chat result, including text-only replies. Gate replay on the current same-owner Session lifecycle and physically redact the appropriate response bodies on deletion/expiry while retaining content-free operation identity. Define separately retained canonical task data explicitly rather than silently relying on it.
findings.verification: Add a normal PostgreSQL integration case that creates a synthetic text-only Session and answer, deletes the Session, retries the original operation, and expects unavailable/410 with the private answer absent from response_body. Repeat with the original thirty-day clock expired and with scoped Chat; a still-live same-owner Session must continue replaying its original result. The root owner should run this verification; this reviewer ran no network or database probe.

findings.criterion: External write integrity: distinguish unknown outcome from confirmed non-write
findings.observation: Confirmed visual defect: the response-loss screen simultaneously says 'Previous outcome is unknown' and 'The contact was not saved.' The fallback catch message asserts a negative result without knowing whether the server committed. The protected retry still uses the original operation, and the supplied later capture shows its canonical created-contact receipt.
findings.evidence: /tmp/get5-product-review-v1/evidence/screenshots/07-contact-response-lost-r6.png (both conflicting statements visibly present); evidence/screenshots/08-contact-same-operation-restored-r6.png (Contact created and canonical source receipt); source/apps/ios/Sources/Features/RelationshipAskView.swift:5049-5053 (fallback), :5670-5683 (unknown-result boundary); evidence/get5-ios-ui-final-r6.log:552 records testCanonicalContactResponseLossRelaunchRetriesSameOperation passing.
findings.user_impact: The recruiter may believe no contact exists and attempt to recreate it elsewhere. This misstates the external-result-to-recovery link even though the built-in retry avoids changing the operation.
findings.recommendation: Use outcome-unknown wording after an ambiguous save failure, such as 'The save result could not be confirmed. Check the original operation.' Reserve 'not saved' for a verified rejection before commit. Make the proposal footer reflect pending reconciliation instead of implying that confirmation has never happened.
findings.verification: Repeat the supplied response-loss/relaunch case and inspect the full card, including its footer. It must contain no definitive 'not saved' or 'nothing changed' assertion before readback; retry must return the same canonical resource and operation receipt.

findings.criterion: Uncertainty: mixed evidence answers must retain the screenshot interpretation boundary
findings.observation: Supported presentation risk: markSessionContextAnswer enforces an unconfirmed screenshot title and proposed status only when an answer has no citations. A response combining unconfirmed screenshot context with one allowed reviewed citation bypasses that marker and remains informational. The provider instructions require attribution, but citation validation checks membership and count, not which claims came from the unconfirmed screenshot. This is not evidence of a particular provider producing a false confirmed claim or of a confirmed-state write.
findings.evidence: /tmp/get5-product-review-v1/source/apps/backend/src/modules/agentSessionSources.ts:6-20; source/apps/backend/src/modules/chat.ts:108-121 and :992-1004; source/apps/backend/src/modules/chatAnswerProvider.ts:367-396 and :485-486. source/apps/backend/src/modules/agentSessions.integration.test.ts:1637-1700 proves the citation-free case; source/apps/backend/src/modules/chatAnswerProvider.test.ts:644-651 proves internally admitted citation-free dialogue, not mixed-source attribution.
findings.user_impact: A recruiter can read a mixed answer as wholly grounded in the displayed reviewed citations, obscuring which part is an earlier screenshot interpretation. The interpretation-to-visible-answer boundary depends on generated wording in this case.
findings.recommendation: Keep an explicit unconfirmed-context indicator whenever screenshot dependencies contributed, including answers with reviewed citations; alternatively separate reviewed claims from screenshot interpretation in typed response blocks. Preserve current reviewed citation IDs and source withdrawal behavior.
findings.verification: Use one reviewed fact and one unresolved screenshot interpretation in a seeded provider result with a valid citation. Verify the visible response still identifies the screenshot portion as unconfirmed and that deleting either relevant source invalidates the corresponding answer as intended. Follow with a bounded actual-provider trial; do not treat a single trial as reliability measurement.

Screenshot context minimization and downstream source tracking are explicit: canonical summary <=700 characters, at most three bounded findings, bounded questions/limitations, <=2000-character source packet and <=12000-character recent history. The ordinary follow-up path reads no raw image or OCR message body and supplies no screenshot-derived reviewed citation. Source fingerprints and same-owner checks are revalidated before storing the result. Evidence: source/apps/backend/src/modules/agentSessionSources.ts:40-86 and :153-201; source/apps/backend/src/modules/agentSessions.ts:815-852 and :956-978; source/apps/backend/src/modules/agentSessions.integration.test.ts:1545-1579 and :1637-1700. The BRIEF reports 121/121 related backend tests, but no independently inspectable backend execution log is present in this frozen manifest.

Screenshot-derived replies and replay bodies retain exact dependencies through forks and are physically redacted after withdrawal; concurrent withdrawal before persistence is rejected. Evidence: source/apps/backend/src/database/055_agent_session_chat_sources.sql:14-76; source/apps/backend/src/modules/agentSessions.integration.test.ts:1702-1800 and :1845-1901. The inspected data inventory has bounded first-party stores: recruiter-authored transcript, composer drafts, proposal fields/source excerpts and receipt identities live in the owner-scoped canonical Session plus protected device cache; raw screenshot content remains in its separate screenshot/capture lifecycle; the new downstream table retains identity and digests only; unscoped audit records store message IDs, provider/prompt metadata and effect counts rather than prompt bodies. Evidence: source/apps/backend/src/database/051_agent_sessions.sql:1-40; source/apps/ios/Sources/Features/RelationshipArchiveModels.swift:633-706; source/apps/backend/src/database/055_agent_session_chat_sources.sql:1-20; source/apps/backend/src/modules/unscopedChat.ts:253-284. missing_evidence: Rubric dimensions scored independently below 3: User authorization 2/4 because the deletion preview omits its canonical effect; uncertainty/conflict 2/4 because unknown-save wording conflicts and mixed screenshot/citation attribution is not deterministically visible; privacy lifecycle 2/4 because text-only response retention/replay is not Session-bound in the inspected code. The packet score 2 is the consequential floor, not an average. The deletion-scope veto determines fail regardless of other scores.

Sensitive inference boundary 2/4: the product slice does not assess or rank people and both conversation and relationship prompts expressly prohibit candidate quality, personality, sensitive-trait and hiring-probability inference (source/apps/agent/src/prompts/assistant-conversation.ts:8 and assistant-relationship.ts:10). The frozen evidence contains no measured direct/proxy-inference red-team result or runtime monitoring proof; a prohibition alone does not earn the rubric's prevention-and-tests anchor.

Evaluator reliability 2/4: this packet uses independent atomic criteria, blind frozen evidence and exact locators, but the supplied packet contains no human-reviewed gold-set calibration, order-swap stability or evaluator drift evidence. Individual synthetic provider trials are not an error-rate estimate; evidence/conversation-provider-proof.json explicitly describes that limitation.

The final actual GLM screenshot follow-up trials, final successful screenshot native-continuity run and local TestFlight rebuild/provider/deployment verification remain owned by root. evidence/get5-ios-ui-final-r7.log:389-391 shows the screenshot fixture selector failure; the BRIEF identifies a DEBUG fixture startup problem, so this cannot establish production upload failure. No physical-device VoiceOver or end-to-end real-device deletion claim is made.

No frozen end-to-end proof covers the proposed text-only deletion/replay case, the mixed reviewed/unconfirmed answer, deletion-dialog comprehension, or changes in permission between preview and execution. The supplied 513-test success is evidenced at evidence/get5-ios-unit-r8.log:1197-1200 and is not a substitute for those missing cases.

A complete field-by-field inventory with backend-at-rest protection, backup deletion, provider retention/training configuration, exports outside the device, and vendor handling is not supplied. The inspected device backup exclusion and purpose-limited query code do not prove those external lifecycles. Jurisdiction-specific compliance conclusions are abstained from; this is a synthetic-data application review, not legal advice or certification.
